evidence.summary: Tablist/tab roles reach the AX tree; aria-selected and roving tabindex correct; all tabs' aria-controls point at the single tabpanel whose aria-labelledby tracks the active tab (verified live before/after activation); arrow keys move focus (manual-activation pattern) and Enter activates with a visible focus ring matching the added CSS; pivot corner header is now a scoped TH with visually-hidden 'Row by column' text; loading/error/empty roles delegated to ModuleDataSection (role=alert / role=status). 31 relevant vitest tests pass including a new test pinning the panel-naming/aria-controls behavior.
